scope: Disposable synthetic SQLite queue; default row-limit admission boundary only.
fixture_population: One normal enqueue plus 9,999 bulk-inserted valid synthetic rows; not 10,000 API ingests or a throughput/soak test.
limitations: No ingestion throughput, latency, sustained load, disk exhaustion, hardware performance or physical acceptance is established. Payload-byte accounting is not total SQLite/WAL disk usage.
sanitization: Aggregate limits, counts and assertions only; no database files, payloads, identities, credentials, record IDs or local paths exported.
